## Implementation Examples {#examples}

### Example 1: Basic Ray Cast

```javascript
// Cast a ray from camera through screen pixel
const ray = {
    origin: State.cam,
    direction: pixelToWorldDirection(x, y)
};

const hit = Scene.trace(ray.origin, ray.direction);
if (hit) {
    // Inject light energy at hit point
    injectLight(hit.position, hit.energy);
}
```

Explained in [Chapter 5: Raytracing](05_raytracing.qmd#reverse-ray-tracing).

### Example 2: Fluid Diffusion Step

```javascript
// Spread light energy to neighbours
function diffuseStep(pixelIndex) {
    const neighbours = [
        pixelIndex - 1,      // left
        pixelIndex + 1,      // right
        pixelIndex - WIDTH,  // top
        pixelIndex + WIDTH   // bottom
    ];
    
    const transfer = CONFIG.DIFFUSION * lattice[pixelIndex];
    for (const n of neighbours) {
        lattice[n] += transfer / 4;
    }
    lattice[pixelIndex] -= transfer;
}
```

Explained in [Chapter 6: Fluids](06_fluids.qmd#diffusion).

### Example 3: Custom Configuration

```javascript
// Override default config for low-end device
const CONFIG = {
    DOWNSAMPLE: 8,           // Lower resolution
    TILE_SIZE: 8,            // Larger tiles
    TIMESTEP_BUDGET_MS: 10,  // Shorter budget
    DISSIPATION: 0.96        // More energy loss
};
```

Tuning guide in [Chapter 8: Troubleshooting](08_troubleshooting.qmd#tuning-guide).
